programs.rightsClaimSummary: Corcept calls relacorilant its proprietary selective cortisol modulator, discloses commercial approved oncology program and a distinct Cushing NDA. Rights and patent licenses/third-party collaboration terms remain subject to SEC-listed patent uncertainty, not independently adjudicated.

sourceDocuments.assertion: Corcept June 30 2026 SEC 10-Q reports relacorilant proprietary program, prior December 30 2025 Cushing CRL, June 17 2026 NDA resubmission, FDA-assigned December 17 2026 PDUFA goal and GRACE/GRADIENT supporting data. Patent scope and enforceability disclosed as risks.
Corcept SEC-filed July 29 2026 corporate update calls December 17 2026 the PDUFA date for Cushing syndrome resubmission, distinct from FDA-approved March 2026 Lifyorli in ovarian indication.

FDA states relacorilant plus nab-paclitaxel approved March 25 2026 for certain platinum-resistant ovarian/fallopian/peritoneal cancer and explicitly identifies pivotal ROSELLA NCT05257408. This is historical, completed original NDA action.
GRACE NCT03697109 Phase 3 Cushing syndrome relacorilant randomized withdrawal pivotal trial.
GRADIENT NCT04308590 Phase 3 in cortisol-secreting adrenal adenomas supportive Cushing clinical evidence.
ROSELLA NCT05257408 Phase 3 relacorilant with nab-paclitaxel ovarian cancer, distinct approved indication.

officialFdaHistoricalAction.indication: Platinum-resistant epithelial ovarian, fallopian tube, or primary peritoneal cancer after one to three prior systemic regimens including bevacizumab

trialLinks.indication: Cushing syndrome from cortisol-secreting adrenal adenomas
Platinum-resistant ovarian fallopian or peritoneal cancer after bevacizumab

programs.rightsClaimSummary: ADMA SEC Q2 2026 filing identifies ASCENIV (formerly RI-002) as company-manufactured marketed product and Biotest AG out-license for Europe, Northern Africa and Middle East. FDA's original BLA 125590 is approved in 2019. This old Phase 3 trial is not a future PDUFA catalyst.

sourceDocuments.assertion: ADMA August 5 2026 SEC Q2 filing identifies FDA-approved marketed ASCENIV, formerly RI-002, original April 2019 approval, 2012 Biotest regional rights out-license, and other marketed IVIG products. Historical trial only.
FDA ASCENIV biological product entry lists licensed product manufacturer ADMA, BLA STN 125590 and April 1 2019 original approval letter; additional 2026 pediatric supplements are separate.
FDA ASCENIV original BLA review identifies ADMA-003 as the sole pivotal Phase 3 trial of RI-002 in 59 PIDD patients, whose study identifier corresponds to NCT01814800 in ClinicalTrials.gov.
ClinicalTrials.gov NCT01814800 original ADMA-003 Phase 3 RI-002 primary immune deficiency trial; completed 2015 and not a new 2026 study.

trialLinks.indication: Primary humoral immunodeficiency (PIDD), original Phase 3 RI-002/ASCENIV
